segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone oily skin describe the mist as lightweight and non-greasy, with one noting it helped control excess oil.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the mist gives a hydration boost and relief from tightness and parched skin, though one with dry sensitive skin reacted with heat and redness.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination acne-prone skin and rosacea reports satisfaction, calling it worth the price even in mini size.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers identifying as sensitive report fast calming of redness, itchiness and irritation, but a minority describe stinging, eyelid peeling or a rosacea flare that took weeks to settle.
segments.mature: One reviewer describing her skin as acneic and middle-aged reports reduced acne redness and improved texture after about a week.

concerns.aging: Only one reviewer links the product to mature skin, reporting reduced acne redness and improved texture; no other aging-specific claims are made.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin describe it as hydrating, soft-absorbing and non-sticky, giving a lasting moisture boost; one reviewer found it not hydrating enough and irritating.
concerns.redness: The large majority report fast, visible reduction in facial redness and flushing (including from rosacea, autoimmune flushing, chlorine exposure, shaving, sunburn), but two reviewers with rosacea/acne rosacea report the product worsened or did not calm their redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say it supports or protects the skin barrier, aids recovery after retinoid or exfoliant use, and soothes damaged or picked skin; one reviewer felt it could not itself heal a damaged barrier.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers describe fewer breakouts, calmer cystic or hormonal acne, and faster healing of active pimples, while a couple report no improvement or a new flare after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers frequently note reduced acne-related redness and inflammation and quicker healing of active blemishes, with one reviewer reporting no real change after a month of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily acne-prone skin reports the mist helped control excess oil; no other oiliness-specific reports appear.

extraits.texte: Bought this product because of its amazing reviews however quicky realized this is definetely not suited for everyone. Caution to those with dry sensitive skin. This product is not hydrating enough and infact caused me irritation. My skin became hot and red I had to immediately wash it off with cold water.

Wanted to love this because it actually calmed redness at first, but as I continued to use it, I noticed it causing a flare in my acne rosacea that has taken almost two weeks to calm down, but it is still very visible. Love the idea of this product, just not for me.

Im 38 and I have acne-prone, oily, dehydrated skin. Not fun. I primarily use this as 1 of 2 toners I use on the daily. I use this first (2 squirts each side, 1 squirt middle of face), then a more hydrating milky toner after. Ive been using it for a couple months now, and it definitely helps in calming the skin when it feels itchy, tight, and red. While the mist feels nice and cloud-like, I wish the product came out more straight-forward so that it doesnt feel like its just being wasted going everywhere and evaporating in 0.5 seconds, if that makes sense. To counter this, I just end up spraying closer to my face so it feels more saturated. Other than that, its a nice product I plan on repurchasing.

I have only been using this product for about a week, so I might add an edit after more time has passed, but so far this might be a new holy grail product for me. My skin is acneic and middle aged. Magnesium in general is a must have for me. I wanted to try something specifically made for the face since products for the body tend to have oils and other comedegenic ingredients. I did buy this on sale and so far I am beyonf wowed. My skin feels better - wish I could explain that better. Acne redness has gone down and the texture has improved as well. I think even slept better when i spritzed this before bestime. Even at full price this is an affordable option compared to other magnesium oils so I will definitely be repurchasing. My skin thanks you Cocokind!

extraits.titre: What I was missing for my sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I deal with hormonal acne (thanks PCOS), dry skin from eczema, and super reactive skin from allergies. Ive struggled for years to find what I can do for my skin throughout the day to soothe it without further irritating my skin the calming magnesium mist is what I was missing! Ive been using it daily for months and have never been able to make it through allergy season without major skin issues but this time Im almost through allergy season and havent had a major reaction once! I love this product so much!

I love this facial mist! Where has it been all my life?! It's so light and refreshing and does a really great job at calming and soothing my skin which is prone to sensitivity and dryness. I spray it on immediately after washing my face and applying serums. It really plays well with other products and I've also noticed it helps control excess oil was and calm inflammatory breakouts. This is one of my new staples!

Literally the BEST facial mist I have ever used!!!! It is such a fine mist but so hydrating and refreshing. I use this daily even multiple times a day I have very sensitive acne prone skin and my skin reacts to anything new I try so I always use the calming magnesium mist during my toner step to help keep my skin calm and stress free. I even use it mid-day for a refresh this facial mist is definitely a multi use product and I will forever use if only we can get a JUMBO
